tei:div.tei:p: (153)rdo rje grau lod kyi bskang ba bzhugs so:

rgyud las/ sman dang gtor ma rak+ta dang*// ma nyams dpal gyi yang phud dang*// sna tshogs sems can mdangs kyis bskor// rol mo dbyangs kyi rgyud dang sbyar// zhes rnal 'byor par nyams chag rdung ba'am rkyen ngan drag po byung na bskang ba bya bar gsungs pa las/ da lta ni tshogs ril lag mgo tsam cig gis rtse mo phra sa de nas phud bshags bsgral gsum yin rung*/ srab shos lcib mo tsam re bcad nas gsol gsol mchod mchod bskang bskang mang pos kha grangs gsog pas lha mnyes par mi 'gyur bas na/ rang lus longs spyod dge tshogs dang bcas pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlab te 'bul bar mos te/ hūm̐: gsang chen rol (154)pa'i gzhal yas nas// dbang chen rdo rje gro bo lod// sras dang sprul pa 'khor dang bcas// bskang ba'i gnas 'dir gsheg su gsol// yid bzhin rin chen 'byung ba'i gter// kun bzang mchod pa bla na med// rgyu mchog chen po rnam pa lnga// gha na tsakra'i longs spyod kyis// bud+dha thod phreng gangs chen mtsho// nam mkha' rnam dag yum dang rol// rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin bcas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs (155)dam bskang*// rdo rje thod phreng rigs kyi gtso// chu khams rnam dag yum dang rol// tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin bcas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// rat+na thod phreng dpal dang ldan// sa khams rnam dag yum dang rol// phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin bcas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// pad+ma thod phreng snang mtha' yas// me khams rnam dag yum dang rol// lhun (156)gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin bcas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// karma thod phreng don yod grub// rlung khams rnam dag yum dang rol// sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin bcas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*/ hūm̐: yid bzhin rin chen 'byung ba'i gter// kun bzang mchod pa bla na med// rgyu mchog chen po rnam pa lnga// gha ṇa tsakra'i longs spyod kyis// dbang gi rgyal po rta mchog dpal// pad+ma gzi ldan yum (157)dang rol// byi la pu shud sprul par bcas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*/

hūm̐: yid bzhin rin chen byung ba'i gter// kun bzang mchod pa bla na med// rgyu mchog chen po rnam pa lnga// gha ṇa tsakra'i longs spyod bcas// dpal chen rdo rje gro bo lod// rdo rje drag mo yum dang rol// smug nag rdo rje khro phur bcas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// phung lnga rnam dag rdo rje'i ging*/(158)'byung lnga dag pa'i yum dang rol// 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i 'khor dang bcas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// 'od zer sprin gyi skyed tshal nas// kun tu bzang mo'i rol pa las// sman btsun rdo rje g.yu sgron ma// gter srung lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// sha khrag dmar gyi gtor mas bskang*// dug gsum gtams pa'i mchod pas bskang*// rmad byung dpal gyi bdud rtsis bskang*// chags pa dmar gyi rak+tas bskang*// (159)dpal gyi yang phud thugs dam bskang*// srog chags mdangs kyis thugs dam bskang*// bdag ni dang po'i las can gyis// nyams shing chags pa dri ma'i tshogs// 'gal 'khrul nongs pa ci mchis pa// dag mnyam chos kyi dbyings su bshags// bskang dang bshags par bya ba rnams// rtog pa'i yul gyi dngos nyid kyang*// chos nyid mi dmigs ye nas dag /ting 'dzin 'di yis dbang bsgyur nas// (160)thugs kyi phyag rgya chen po 'grub/ ces yi ge brgya pa brjod/ bla ma nor li'i ngor/ pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis bris pa dge'o/// // /////////////////////////////////////////////
